[[File:Blessed bone shards detail.png|150px|left]]
'''Blessed bone shards''' are used to make sacrifices at the [[libation bowl]] at [[the Teomat]], requiring level 30 [[Prayer]]. Each bone shard sacrificed gives 5 [[Prayer]] experience with [[Jug of blessed wine|blessed wine]], or 6 experience with [[Jug of blessed sunfire wine|blessed sunfire wine]].  One jug of blessed wine needs to be used for every 400 bone shards.

To make sacrifices, the libation bowl must be filled with [[Jug of blessed wine|jugs of blessed wine]] or [[Jug of blessed sunfire wine|jugs of blessed sunfire wine]], and the player must have at least 2 [[Prayer points]] to perform it. The passive effect of [[Zealot's robes]] can be used to save some shards while sacrificing them. The chance to preserve material is calculated for each individual shard, rather than the entire set of 100 for every action taken.

Up to 100 shards can be sacrificed per action at the libation bowl. Each jug of blessed (sunfire) wine poured into the libation bowl allows for 400 shards to be sacrificed.

===How to obtain===
Blessed bone shards can be obtained from various activities in [[Varlamore]], such as breaking down [[sun-kissed bones]] and [[blessed bone statuette]]s, mining [[calcified rocks]], blessing bones at the [[exposed altar]], and rummaging through offerings from [[Vale Totems]]. Additionally, you have a chance at obtaining shards when opening [[Hunters' loot sack|Hunters' loot sacks]] after completing [[Hunters' Rumours]], when opening the [[Lunar Chest]], and by doing the [[Colossal Wyrm Agility Course]].

==Blessing bones==

Breaking down blessed bones with a [[chisel]] requires first blessing the bones at the [[exposed altar]], found south of [[the Teomat]].
